matthew.24.p1.b1.text: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.

matthew.24.p1.b2.text: Do you see all these things?

matthew.24.p1.b3.text: Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.

matthew.24.p2.b1.text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately.

matthew.24.p2.b2.text: Tell us … when will these things happen

matthew.24.p2.b3.text: and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?

matthew.24.p3.b1.text: See to it that no one deceives you.

matthew.24.p3.b2.text: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.

matthew.24.p3.b3.text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. …

matthew.24.p3.b4.text: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

matthew.24.p4.b1.text: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.

matthew.24.p4.b2.text: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,

matthew.24.p4.b3.text: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.

matthew.24.p5.b1.text: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.

matthew.24.p5.b2.text: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

matthew.24.p5.b3.text: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

matthew.24.p6.b1.text: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel …

matthew.24.p6.b2.text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

matthew.24.p6.b3.text: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.

matthew.24.p6.b4.text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.

matthew.24.p7.b1.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!

matthew.24.p7.b2.text: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.

matthew.24.p7.b3.text: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.

matthew.24.p7.b4.text: … But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.

matthew.24.p8.b1.text: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out

matthew.24.p8.b2.text: or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

matthew.24.p8.b3.text: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

matthew.24.p8.b4.text: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

matthew.24.p9.b1.text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened

matthew.24.p9.b2.text: and the moon will not give its light

matthew.24.p9.b3.text: the stars will fall from the sky

matthew.24.p9.b4.text: and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’

matthew.24.p10.b1.text: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven

matthew.24.p10.b2.text: and all the tribes of the earth will mourn.

matthew.24.p10.b3.text: They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

matthew.24.p10.b4.text: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

matthew.24.p11.b1.text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree

matthew.24.p11.b2.text: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.

matthew.24.p11.b3.text: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.

matthew.24.p11.b4.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

matthew.24.p12.b1.text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

matthew.24.p12.b2.text: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage

matthew.24.p12.b3.text: up to the day Noah entered the ark.

matthew.24.p12.b4.text: And they were oblivious, until the flood came and swept them all away.

matthew.24.p13.b1.text: Two men will be in the field

matthew.24.p13.b2.text: one will be taken and the other left.

matthew.24.p13.b3.text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.

matthew.24.p13.b4.text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.

matthew.24.p14.b1.text: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming

matthew.24.p14.b2.text: he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

matthew.24.p14.b3.text: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.

matthew.24.p15.b1.text: Who then is the faithful and wise servant

matthew.24.p15.b2.text: whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?

matthew.24.p15.b3.text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

matthew.24.p15.b4.text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

matthew.24.p16.b1.text: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart

matthew.24.p16.b2.text: My master will be away a long time.

matthew.24.p16.b3.text: And he begins to beat his fellow servants

matthew.24.p16.b4.text: and to eat and drink with drunkards.

matthew.24.p17.b1.text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.

matthew.24.p17.b2.text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
